title: Place a door of a given type into an existing wall
task: Place a hosted FamilyInstance (a door) in a wall: find the FamilySymbol by category and name, call FamilySymbol.Activate() before use, then Document.Create.NewFamilyInstance(point, symbol, hostWall, level, StructuralType.NonStructural) at a point on the wall's location line; verify FamilyInstance.Host. The script creates one scratch host wall.

pitfalls.symptom: NewFamilyInstance throws for a symbol that exists in the project.
pitfalls.cause: The FamilySymbol is not active (never placed).
pitfalls.fix: Call symbol.Activate() inside the transaction block before NewFamilyInstance (step 3).

pitfalls.symptom: The door is created but not hosted, or lands away from the wall.
pitfalls.cause: The insertion point is not on the host wall's location line.
pitfalls.fix: Evaluate a point on (hostWall.Location as LocationCurve).Curve (step 4).

pitfalls.cause: The project template has no door family loaded.
pitfalls.fix: Load one with Document.LoadFamily between transaction blocks, then place inside one.
